title: GitHub Contributions Chart — Fix for PP-Namias
description: Fix GitHub contribution chart to display PP-Namias contributions. Root cause: Next.js 16 Turbopack fetch override fails for external HTTPS APIs on Node.js 24.

context.rootCause: Next.js 16 Turbopack patches fetch() in server context. On Node.js 24, the patched fetch fails DNS resolution for external HTTPS endpoints. Node.js native https module works fine.
context.solution: Replace all fetch() calls to external APIs with httpsFetch() utility using Node.js native https module.
